data.gender_notes: Harding is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'heard', meaning 'hard'. The name Harding is of English origin and is a compound of 'hard' and 'ing'. It is a masculine name and has been used throughout history in various cultures. In English literature, it is often associated with strength, courage, and bravery. The name Harding carries the meaning “Hard, brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harding usually hope their child will grow to embody hard, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
